nodes.label: HAG-54 Report: Hotel-Core Slice (10 files)
nodes.rationale: No alert-only stubs existed in the slice; the one genuine dead control found was Dashboard.jsx's assign-cleaning button, which called PUT /housekeeping/assignee/${roomId} with a room number where the backend keys the route by numeric housekeeping row id, so any non-numeric room number failed with a DECIMAL-truncation 500 while the UI reported success. Fixed by adding resolveHousekeepingId() that passes numeric keys through and otherwise resolves the room number via the rooms state already loaded from GET /housekeeping. Two backend defects were reported instead of fixed: GET /api/assignments ignores all role/name filters, and GET /api/reports/data returns 400 'Report type required'.

nodes.label: resolveHousekeepingId() fix in Dashboard.jsx
nodes.rationale: The assign-cleaning button silently failed for most room numbers because PUT /housekeeping/assignee/:id is keyed by the numeric housekeeping row id while getRoomTaskKey() supplies a room number; the backend answered 200 for '141' but 500 {'error':"Truncated incorrect DECIMAL value: 'ANG500'"} for alphanumeric keys while the UI reported success. resolveHousekeepingId(roomId, rooms) passes numeric keys through and otherwise resolves the room number to its row id via the rooms state already loaded from GET /housekeeping, so the three-call sequence (assignee write, status flip to Vacant Dirty, housekeeping message) now actually completes.
